payload.report_excerpt: Preference optimisation reduces the alignment tax by roughly 40% relative to supervised fine-tuning alone, which is why it has become the default post-training step [Okonkwo, 2023].
payload.source_excerpt: We compare supervised fine-tuning with a preference-optimisation stage on three held-out capability suites. The preference-optimised model is preferred by annotators more often; capability regressions relative to the base model persist in both arms and we do not quantify their magnitude.
